verdict.rationale: NVIDIA ships official, documented SDKs across the Isaac stack. Isaac Sim offers pip-installable Python namespace packages for composing apps and writing standalone scripts that control robots and environments. Isaac Lab is an open-source, extensible robot-learning framework. Isaac ROS provides production-ready packages and the NITROS transport. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs, and evidence of API reference depth or version stability (a 3.0 migration guide notes breaking changes).
